decisions.reason: As a distant niche product with only brief website mention and no signs of follow-on investment, its uncertainty appears resolved unfavorably and the option is no longer worth keeping open.
The medical examination light disappeared from the website after its launch year, which is a strong signal that demand or strategic fit was too weak to justify further commitment.
This product stayed prominently presented and even received a new LED replacement kit, indicating positive market feedback and strong fit with the firm's industrial and maritime lighting strengths.
The designer task light remained on its own page across multiple years after a relaunch, suggesting validated demand in a segment close to the core business and low cost of continuation.
The pendant office luminaire was only visible in its launch year, so by 2022 the evidence points to limited traction and little reason to keep this option open.
The premium pendant luminaire also appears to have lacked persistence after launch, making it a weak option relative to the firm's other, better-supported lighting lines.
